The test image shows a soybean leaf with clear **interveinal chlorosis** — yellowing between the veins while veins remain green — plus scattered small reddish-brown necrotic spots. This is the hallmark foliar symptom of Sudden Death Syndrome (SDS).

The SDS reference collage confirms this pattern: the upper-right panel shows identical interveinal chlorosis with green veins, matching the test image closely. The small brown spots in the test image represent early necrotic lesions consistent with SDS progression.
